letter:
Dear Grace Kim,

Thank you for your application MIA-2026-1156 for a 520 sq ft accessory dwelling unit at 1530 Banyan Grove Lane. We reviewed your documents against the ADU rules and found that every requirement is met:

1. The lot is in T3-R and has no existing ADU.
2. The unit is 520 sq ft, under the 800 sq ft limit.
3. The setbacks are 10 ft 0 in at the rear and 7 ft 6 in at the side, and the survey agrees.
4. Your owner-occupancy affidavit is notarised.
5. The elevation certificate shows the floor 1.6 ft above the base flood elevation.

No further documents are needed. When the permit is issued you will receive a notice with the inspection schedule.

If you have questions, call (305) 555-0100 or reply through the applicant portal.

Building Department, City of Miami
